result.topic_en: Calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: linear transformations between body-fixed and moving coordinates (direction cosines), the hydrodynamic equations of motion in transformed coordinates, angular velocities p, q, r, and expressions for the potential V and pressure p, with a German aphorism signed F. A. Wolf at top right.

methods.what: Linear transformation from initial-position (Lagrangian) coordinates to current coordinates
Ellipsoid surface condition preserved under the motion
Rotation to principal-axis coordinates via direction cosines
Coefficients l, m as products of semi-axes and direction cosines
Euler equations of motion transformed to coordinates ξ, η, ζ
Angular velocity components defined from derivatives of direction cosines
